summary.en: U.S. stocks are mixed in premarket trading as investors weigh soft inflation data against escalating Middle East tensions, with oil surging and Treasury yields hitting eight-week highs. Bank earnings boosts sentiment but geopolitical risk premium is weighing on broader equities.
summary.zh: 美股盘前交易呈现分歧，投资者在软通胀数据与中东紧张局势升级之间权衡：油价飙升、美债收益率创八周新高。银行股业绩提振情绪，但地缘政治风险溢价抑制大盘表现。

title.en: Oil Surges as US Reinstates Blockade on Iran Strait of Hormuz
title.zh: 美国重启对伊朗霍尔木兹海峡封锁，油价飙升

impact.en: Energy prices jumped 3.5% with Brent at $86.22, raising inflation concerns and pressuring rate-sensitive sectors like airlines, utilities, and REITs.
impact.zh: 能源价格跃升 3.5%，布伦特原油达$86.22，引发通胀担忧并压制对利率敏感的航空、公用事业和 REITs 板块。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Geopolitical supply shock: US-Iran hostilities near Strait of Hormuz threaten 20% of global energy flows, pushing inflation expectations higher and pressuring Fed policy flexibility.
macroRisk.zh: 是——地缘政治供应冲击：霍尔木兹海峡附近的美伊冲突威胁全球 20% 的能源流动，推高通胀预期并压制美联储政策灵活性。

title.en: U.S. CPI Drops to 3.5%, Down from May's Three-Year High
title.zh: 美国 CPI 降至 3.5%，低于今年五月三年高位

impact.en: Softer inflation (headline -0.4% monthly, YoY down to 3.5%) provides room for Fed patience but is overshadowed by oil shock. Market consensus was ~3.8%, beat helps sentiment.
impact.zh: 通胀降温（环比降 0.4%，同比至 3.5%）为美联储耐心提供空间，但被油价冲击掩盖。数据好于~3.8%的市场共识提振情绪。

macroRisk.en: Mixed - Inflation relief vs oil inflation: Core CPI improvement helps, but energy shock creates sticky inflation risk that could derail Fed hiking cycle.
macroRisk.zh: 分化——通胀缓解与油价冲击：核心通胀改善有助，但能源冲击制造粘性通胀风险可能破坏美联储加息周期。

title.en: 10-Year Treasury Yields Hit Eight-Week High on Middle East Escalation
title.zh: 美债 10Y 收益率因中东升级创八周新高

impact.en: US, EU and UK 10Y yields rose to four.636%, 3.114% and 5.045% respectively on rate-sensitive positioning amid Middle East conflict escalating.
impact.zh: 美欧英 10Y 收益率分别升至四。636%/三。114%/五。045%，中东冲突升级下的利率敏感配置推升债券收益率。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Yield spike: Rates at 8-week high of ~4.636% press on equities and make fixed income less attractive; flight-to-quality signals stress.
macroRisk.zh: 是——收益率飙升：利率创八周~四。636%高位压制股票、使固定收益吸引力减弱；避险情绪显露压力信号。

title.en: Dow Futures Edge Lower on US-Iran Tensions, Nasdaq Leads Gains
title.zh: 道指期货因美伊紧张承压，纳斯达克领涨

impact.en: Futures mixed: Dow -0.04%, S&P +0.38%, Nasdaq +0.9%. Tech sector defensive on AI growth despite broader market unease from geopolitics.
impact.zh: 期货分歧：道指降 四。四%、标普升三。八%、纳指升九。技术板块在 AI 增长支撑下具防御性，但地缘政治整体市场不安。

macroRisk.en: Moderate - Sector rotation: Geopolitical risk favors big tech cash generation over consumer discretionary, but broader equity sentiment is neutral.
macroRisk.zh: 中等——板块轮动：地缘政治风险利好大科技现金生成而非可选消费，但大盘情绪中性。

title.en: Fed Governor Waller Says Rate Hike Remains on Table if Inflation Stays Firm
title.zh: 美联储沃勒称通胀保持坚挺则加息仍摆在桌上

impact.en: Hawkish tone from Fed leadership after softer CPI but with Warsh testimony ahead; policy flexibility signals keep markets watching closely.
impact.zh: 在软通胀后联邦储备鹰派表态，但瓦拉赫证词在即；政策灵活性信号使市场密切关注。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Policy uncertainty: Fed pause less likely, keeping growth and tech elevated while rate-sensitive sectors face headwinds.
macroRisk.zh: 是——政策不确定性：美联储暂停可能性降低，利好成长与科技股但利率敏感板块承压。

ai.en: AI chipmakers and infrastructure hold strength despite macro noise; NVIDIA, Broadcom leading as data center demand remains resilient to inflation shocks.
ai.zh: 尽管宏观噪音，AI 芯片制造商和基础设施表现强劲；英伟达、博通领跑数据中心需求对通胀冲击保持韧性。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductors mixed with NVIDIA, AMD up on earnings but memory chips pressured by macro; sector watching Fed rate path and energy costs closely.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体分歧：英伟达、AMD 业绩上涨但存储芯片受宏观压制；板块密切关注美联储利率路径和能源成本。

bigTech.en: Big Tech defensive on AI growth but broader earnings cloud uncertain. Microsoft, Apple trade neutral amid macro uncertainty.
bigTech.zh: 大科技在 AI 增长支撑下具防御性但更广泛业绩云不确定。微软、苹果在中宏观不确定性中交易中性。

energy.en: Energy sector surging on Brent $86.22 surge and geopolitical premium; OXY, CVX leading gains as supply fears dominate.
energy.zh: 能源板块在布伦特$八十六二二飙升和地缘政治溢价推动下上涨；OXY、CVX 领涨供应担忧主导。

ev.en: EV sector pressured by oil price surge and rate sensitivity; demand softens as gasoline substitutes become less competitive on cost.
ev.zh: 电动车板块受油价飙升和利率敏感压制；需求因汽油替代品成本竞争力减弱而放缓。

market.en: Broader equity sentiment mixed: growth/tech rallies while consumer discretionary and financials pressured by inflation/oil shock.
market.zh: 大盘情绪分歧：成长股反弹但可选消费和金融业受通胀油价冲击压制。

preciousMetals.en: Gold, silver attract safe-haven flows on Middle East risk and yield volatility; GLD up amid geopolitical stress.
preciousMetals.zh: 金银在中东风险和收益率波动吸引避险资金；GLD 随地缘政治压力上涨。

oil.en: WTI near $79.50, Brent at $86.22; Strait of Hormuz blockade fears keep energy in premium trading despite supply glut concerns.
oil.zh: 西德克萨斯原油近$ 七十九五，布伦特$八十六二二；霍尔木兹海峡封锁恐惧使能源保持溢价交易尽管供应过剩担忧。

futures.en: Dow futures -0.04% to ~52,780; S&P +0.38%, Nasdaq +0.9%; Dow edge lower but tech-led index gains dominate.
futures.zh: 道指期货降四。零一%至~五二七八零；标普升三。八%，纳指升九；道指微跌但科技股主导的指数涨幅占据上风。

treasury10Y.en: ~4.636%, up from recent lows on Middle East escalation and oil shock; yield-sensitive sectors face headwinds.
treasury10Y.zh: ~四。六三六%，在中东升级和油价冲击下从近期低点反弹；收益率敏感板块承压。

dxy.en: $1.09-1.10, modest strengthening on safe-haven demand; dollar holds as risk-off flows from Middle East tensions.
dxy.zh: $一零九至一一零，避险需求下适度走强；风险规避资金因中东紧张使美元持有。

oil.en: WTI ~$79.50, Brent $86.22; energy supplies at risk as US strikes on Iran intensify.
oil.zh: 西德克萨斯原油~$ 七十九五，布伦特$八十六二二；美国对伊朗的袭击加剧能源供应风险。

keyRisk.en: US-Iran hostilities near Strait of Hormuz threaten global energy flows; Trump's proposed cargo fee adds trade uncertainty.
keyRisk.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡附近的美伊冲突威胁全球能源流动；特朗普提出的货物费用增加贸易不确定性。

note.en: Geopolitical risk (Middle East tensions) dominates with mixed sentiment: energy and gold rally while growth faces inflation/yield headwinds; tech provides partial support.
note.zh: 地缘政治风险（中东紧张局势）主导市场分歧情绪：能源和黄金反弹但成长股面临通胀收益率逆风；科技提供部分支撑。
